newsitem.title: USA: Angelica expects Q4 to be close to year-ago.
newsitem.headline: Angelica expects Q4 to be close to year-ago.

text.p: Angelica Corp, reporting lower third-quarter results, said Wednesday it expects its fourth-quarter results to be close to last year's fourth quarter before a restructuring charge.
In the year-ago fourth quarter, the company reported a loss of $0.85 per share that included a $0.95 per share restructuring charge.

Long term, the company said its prospects continue to be encouraging. In time, decisions by hospitals to outsource their textile processing needs in order to cut costs will provide sufficient additional revenues to overcome margin pressures the company is now experiencing, it said.
For the October 26 third quarter, Angelica reported earnings of $0.20 per share, down from $0.31 per share a year ago.

The company, which supplies textile rental and laundry services to health care institutions, and manufactures uniforms for institutions and busineses, also said its efforts to establish alliances with other health care suppliers should result in greater sales and revenue levels in the future.
